Chapter 6771: Fortune

Chapter 6771: Fortune

Yudi was right since he was the strongest currently, not to mention having an overlord as a backer. The brilliance of Phoenix Emperor couldn’t overcome this.

“You must do what is best for Sky Zenith.” Phoenix Emperor disagreed and started introducing: “The immortals are here. Offer it to them as a gift and be blessed with good fortune.”

The crowd listened attentively while Yudi focused his gaze toward Li Qiye and Xiaoyue. Li Qiye had a mortal body and nothing stood out about Xiaoyue. However, he also saw Dragon Ancestor serving Li Qiye.

“Immortals from where?” He asked. His heavenly gaze revealed a mortal body.

How could an immortal have a mortal body? Concealing one’s cultivation was a different issue.

After all, everyone knew a mortal shell couldn’t contain the power of an immortal. It would just implode into pieces. Nonetheless, he knew Dragon Ancestor was proud and would rather die than submit.

“You aren’t qualified to know. Hand over the cauldron and I will spare you.” Li Qiye said while relaxing.

Xiaoyue only gave him a disdainful glance, something he hadn’t experienced before.

As for spectators, they never thought they would see the day when ancient ancestors were treated like this.

“My horizon is narrow so I do not know of your identity. I have been fortunate enough to visit Ancient World before to meet Likeheaven Immortal Monarch. May I ask if you are from Ancient as well?” Yudi bowed.

“He went to Ancient?” Others had no idea but Phoenix Emperor and similar characters were aware of this rumor.

Ancient was one of the nine major worlds. The minor worlds were under their jurisdiction. In the minor worlds, overlords were rare enough, let alone immortals.

The same couldn’t be said about the major worlds. Immortals were there to spread the dao so everyone hoped to visit the major worlds.

Unfortunately, this was not an easy task. Leaving a minor world was virtually impossible, let alone entering a major world. Thus, Yudi had such an honorable event in his life.

“It made sense that he became the strongest.” An emperor took a deep breath.

“This is part of his greatness, maybe he can become an overlord later.” An ancient ancestor murmured.

“So someone else has visited a major world outside of Yellow Sky.” One emperor remarked.

Yellow Sky was the only beastmaster who had surpassed the divine level. This person left and entered the major world.

As for Li Qiye, he didn’t react at all.

“Likeheaven Immortal Monarch.” Xiaoyue smirked.

“Yes, a primordial immortal.” Yudi gained more confidence since his backer was amazing. He emphasized the word ‘primordial’.

Regular cultivators didn’t know the various stages because immortals were far above their reach. However, Dragon Ancestor and Phoenix Emperor knew of primordial immortals. There weren’t that many in all of Heaven Realm.

The atmosphere became tense for the crowd. None dared to utter a single word.

“Is that a threat?” Xiaoyue smirked again.

“Of course not, I have nothing but respect for the immortals and yearn to visit your world, which is...?” Yudi bowed again.

He was sure that Likeheaven Immortal Monarch, one of the nine legends, would be enough to scare anyone. Beastmaster was under the jurisdiction of this primordial immortal. Anything done here could be viewed as a transgression.

“Unfortunately, you are mistaken. A primordial immortal is nothing before the young noble.” Xiaoyue shook her head.

“Miss, disrespecting primordial immortals is a grave offense.” Yudi’s expression changed.
